x: Lacey) Geoff North just gets home ahead of Blackheath's John Herring in the Sward invitation 2 miles.
Next to take over was Jack Brown, but not surprisingly he had to give way to 'kipper' Herring who pulverised the opposition, and took Blackheath from 7th into a 100 yard lead.

In the 3 miles 'Kipper' Herring of Blackheath was in a class apart from the rest of the field,beating the championship best by 20secs. The race for the minor positions was a different kettle of fish though,Barry Collins and Bob Holt just managing to get away from Mel Thorpe in the latter stages.
